basic_info.description: Beautifully Updated Condo w/ Exclusive-Use Yard in a Coveted Location! Wander past a lush tapestry of bougainvillea & step into this thoughtfully updated residence in a boutique 2-unit HOA perfectly positioned just 1 blk from Union Street, in the heart of vibrant Cow Hollow & moments from the best of the Marina District. This charming Edwardian home has been extensively modernized while preserving its classic details. LR's elegant marble-tiled, wb frplc anchors the dbl parlor, offering the flexibility of a spacious front bdrm or formal living space. Sunlight streams across newly refinished hdwd floors. The kitchen & laundry are conveniently located on the main lvl, w/ a bright, open living/dining space at the rear of the home. The chef's kitchen is a true showstopper, featuring a large stone island w/ counter seating, brkfst nook overlooking the exclusive-use deck & premium appliances including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Viking gas range w/ hood & Bosch dishwasher. A custom wood banister guides you to the lwr lvl, where you'll find a generous prmry ste w/ private access to the serene, exclusive-use rear yard, plus a spacious 2nd en suite bdrm. Both bdrms feature large closets. 3 baths fully renovated w/ designer tile, new vanities, contemporary hardware & sophisticated finishes.
